summary.text:
# 丰饶计划 / Project Cornucopia

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/federations_events_1.txt:13-27

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 决议“工业：丰饶计划”（resolution_industry_project_cornucopia）通过时由其 effect 在3天后触发（common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:3255）。
  Fired 3 days after the resolution "Project Cornucopia" passes (its effect, common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:3255).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「丰饶计划」：来自银河社群各国的工程师交流开发资源的办法；窗口只告知“丰饶计划”殖民地决议现已可用，选项仅确认。
  "Project Cornucopia": engineers from across the Galactic Community share ways to exploit resources; the window only announces that the Project Cornucopia colony decision is now available, and the option merely acknowledges it.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
